mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_apply (apply_user_id, item_id, message, apply_status) VALUES (#{applyUserId}, #{itemId}, #{message}, #{applyStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.username AS apply_username, i.item_name FROM exchange_apply e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON e.apply_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN idle_item i ON e.item_id = i.id WHERE e.apply_user_id = #{applyUserId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE exchange_apply SET apply_status = #{applyStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
